puzzles.name: Invisible Platform Path
puzzles.description: Cross a seemingly empty chasm using invisible platforms only visible with Lens of Truth.
steps: Platforms appear as translucent blue squares

puzzles.name: Fake Wall Maze
puzzles.description: Navigate maze where some walls are illusions. Lens of Truth reveals passable walls.

puzzles.name: Dead Hand Encounter
puzzles.description: Defeat Dead Hand - invisible body with visible hands. Lens of Truth reveals body.

puzzles.name: ReDead Sun Song Puzzle
puzzles.description: Stun ReDeads and Gibdos with Sun's Song to pass safely or attack.
steps: Song also freezes time of day

puzzles.name: Spike Trap Corridor
puzzles.description: Navigate corridor with moving spike traps. Timing and Hover Boots required.

puzzles.name: Bongo Bongo Drum Stage
puzzles.description: Fight Bongo Bongo on collapsing drum stage. Hover Boots essential. Lens reveals invisible body.
steps: Stage is giant drum - collapses when hit
Equip Hover Boots - float above drum
Equip Lens of Truth - see invisible body
Bongo Bongo has two hands + invisible body
Attack body when both hands stunned
hints: Sheik: "The drum beats for the dead..."
Hands drum on stage - body floats above

phases.name: Hand Drumming
phases.mechanic: Two giant hands drum on stage, creating shockwaves. Body invisible above.
phases.puzzle: Longshot hands to stun them simultaneously, then attack body

phases.name: Stage Collapse
phases.mechanic: Drum stage breaks into floating platforms
phases.puzzle: Hover Boots essential - float between platforms, Longshot hands

phases.name: Frenzy
phases.mechanic: Low health - hands move faster, body teleports
phases.puzzle: Quick Longshots, Lens essential for tracking body
phases.vulnerability: Body teleport has tell - screen distortion
